A '''Hutt Temple''' was a structure built and dedicated to the various [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] deities. [[Da Soocha]]'s moon [[Napdu]] was the site of one such temple called [[Maya Armus]] which also doubled as a health spa open to the public.<ref name="Legacy">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref>
